title: Algebra-valued Koszul cohomology sheaf comparison
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], with $Y$ Noetherian. Suppose each point of $Z$ has an affine neighborhood on $Y$ whose ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ be locally constant and equal to the stalk finrank [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] of the tensor pullback of the ideal sheaf [def-pc-module-pullback]. Put $A=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and $g:(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to(Y,A)$ using [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Choose derived categories on $Y$ and over $A$ with independent universes [def-pc-derived-category]. For any right adjoint $H$ of derived scalar restriction $D(A)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ and every $n\in\mathbb Z$, there is an isomorphism of $A$-module sheaves from $H^n(H(\mathcal O_Y))$ to $g_*$ of the degree-$n$ locally-ranked exterior term [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex] of the internal dual [def-pur-sheaf-hom] of the tensor pullback of the ideal sheaf, with rank function $r$. Here ordinary module direct image is that of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. This asserts cohomology sheaf isomorphisms only.

proof.text: Use the algebra-valued affine derived Hom adjunction for i (a closed immersion is affine), then uniqueness of right adjoints to pass to H. The precomposition action is the i_*OZ-module action on Hom(i_*OZ,J). Restrict the derived internal Hom calculation to affine open charts using the open restriction comparison.

Choose the Koszul generators supplied by hregular near a point of Z. The quotient augmentation from the dual-Koszul node is a quasi-isomorphism; its finite free bounded Koszul model computes derived Hom by the bounded-above finite-free model theorem. Dual-Koszul cohomology vanishes away from the length, and the intrinsic Ext determinant comparison is linear for precomposition by multiplication in the quotient.

On the quotient chart the conormal is I/I². Vanishing of positive Koszul homology shows that the regular generator classes give a quotient-module basis. Its stalk finrank equals the length, hence hr identifies this with r. Affine module correspondence identifies the top exterior dual conormal module with the exterior sheaf in the statement.

The intrinsic Ext identifications commute with changes of regular generators and localization. Glue their algebra-linear cohomology sheaf maps on chart intersections. On the clopen fiber of r at n only degree n survives, giving g_* locallyRankedExteriorTerm in that degree. Off Z, i_*OZ has zero stalks and so does every module over it. Negative degrees vanish. Empty Z and rank zero give the zero calculation and Hom(A,A)=A respectively. This proves only the cohomology comparison, with no derived reconstruction.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_algebraDual_homology {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f)
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (hr : ∀ z : Z, r z = Module.finrank (Z.presheaf.stalk z)
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace z).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)))
    (H : schemeDerivedCategory Y ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (adjH : (SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      (R := moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
      (R' := moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))
      ⟨Functor.whiskerRight i.c (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)⟩).rightDerivedFunctor ⊣ H) (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj
        (H.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf))) ≅
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm
          (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Z.sheaf)
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules)
            (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)) r n))
